main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of 10-bar excess forward return on forecast (trending grid bars)
main_measure.threshold: confirm needs t >= 2 (with check negative, t <= -2); reject if t <= -2 (or check positive, t >= +2)

supporting_check.name: mean excess return s>=14 minus 8<=s<14 (Welch t) (t=-0.382)

reading: Situation is regime == 'trending' and expected side is the sign of the graded shape of s (run's standardised value); the coin's mean 10-bar return is taken over all grid bars of all its windows; a tier below 20 cases is treated as a minimum count not reached (not observable).
decided_by: Inconclusive rule: enough cases, but neither confirm (slope t >= 2 with check t <= -2) nor reject (slope t <= -2 or check t >= +2) holds.
